blocks.text: Porn addiction refers to an addiction to pornographic videos or images, marked by an intense desire for viewing these despite adverse consequences on one’s life. It affects individuals of all ages worldwide and this problem continues to rise rapidly affecting millions worldwide; fortunately, there are treatment options available such as withdrawal for those struggling with this form of dependency.

blocks.text: How Does Porn Addiction Withdrawal Affect the Brain?
blocks.html: How Does Porn Addiction Withdrawal Affect the Brain?

blocks.text: Withdrawing from Porn Addiction is similar to withdrawal from other types of addiction: Your brain experiences changes in dopamine levels as you attempt to discontinue. Dopamine is a neurotransmitter linked with pleasure and motivation released when we engage in activities which give pleasure or motivation, such as eating, having sexual contact or using drugs. When we try to quit our addiction we release more dopamine which contributes to feeling happy such as eating, having sexual contact or using drugs which makes us happy; dopamine levels may drop when trying to quit; dopamine levels rise as we move closer towards stopping.

blocks.text: Addiction to porn can make your brain dependent upon its high dopamine release when viewing pornographic material; when trying to stop, these high levels don’t come rushing in and may lead to withdrawal symptoms as your mind gets used to being fed that high dose.
